subject: West Hall A - urgent booth power + internet outage; speaker fallback
message_1_cc: Meridian Center Ops <ops@meridiancenter.com>, Venue AV - Onsite <av@meridian-audio.com>
message_1_subject: Immediate: West Hall A - trade aisle power dip and internet drop
message_1_body:
Hi Irene / Marissa,

Sorry to flag first thing but we just had a partial power dip in West Hall A (aisles 3–6) that took down several exhibitor breakout booths and the local wired internet switch. A handful of booths report intermittent lighting and the wall ports are dead. AV reported packet loss on the wired VLAN and the primary breaker for row 4 popped.

What we know: 
- Time: ~07:05 PT
- Affected: ~8 booths including Redwood Inference (booth 4B)
- Immediate risk: exhibitor demo systems offline, USB mics not powering up, and the house internet gateway in the hall resetting repeatedly.

Actions underway from our side: 
- Ops on-site (2 techs) en route to breaker closet.
- AV has dispatched an engineer to check the switch and backup UPS.
- We can mobilize on-site generator but it takes ~25–40 mins to hook up safely.

If you want us to prioritize your booth for temporary power or provide a bonded cellular internet, we can do that now. Also let us know if any scheduled talks need remote fallback details so we can provision a clean stream.

Uploading quick photos and the hall floorplan to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gv_example_event_assets

—Hank
Hank Lang
Venue Operations Manager, Meridian Center
Attachment: site_photos.jpg (2.1MB), floorplan.pdf (520KB)
message_2_subject: Re: Immediate: West Hall A - trade aisle power dip and internet drop
message_2_body:
Thanks Hank — please prioritize Booth 4B (Redwood demo) for temporary power and a cellular internet fallback.

Marissa / Dylan — can we: 
1) Confirm a UPS + battery tower to keep demos live for the next 3 hours?
2) Kick off bonded-SIM fallback for booth network (please confirm APN and activation ETA with Venue AV).
3) Prepare remote speaker fallback for our 10:30 talk (Aperture Analytics co-presenting) — if their speaker can’t make it, we’ll need a dial-in + backup laptop at the podium.

Marissa — please coordinate with Hank on the generator hookup if UPS isn’t holding. Dylan — loop in AV for the SIM plan and give me a live update by 07:45. I’m standing by to escalate to the sponsor if needed.

Irene
Irene Choi | Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0192
message_3_subject: Re: Immediate: West Hall A - trade aisle power dip and internet drop
message_3_body:
On it. Quick status: 
- I have ops on-site running continuity checks on breaker #4; they say it tripped, likely a loose neutral. If they can’t re-seat safely we’ll need the generator. 
- I’m dispatching our crate with two 1kVA UPS towers and a couple of APC battery packs to booth 4B now (eta ~12 mins).
- I’ll request a temporary power run from generator if the breaker won’t hold; Hank please confirm the nearest safe hook-up point for a single-circuit run.
- Attaching the floorplan so ops knows cable routes.

Dylan — can you message Venue AV and get the SIM failover APN and an idea of how many concurrent streams the bonded link can support? If bonded can handle 2–3Mbps steady we can run the demo plus a remote presenter stream.

Also, Jasmine — please prep a standby laptop with our presenter credentials and a Teams/Zoom link ready to go. If the sponsor wants to pre-record, we can run their file from our laptop.

Attachment: floorplan.pdf
—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Events Lead, Redwood Inference
Desk: (415) 555-0123
message_4_subject: Re: 10:30 session — possible delay / remote option
message_4_body:
Hi Irene / Marissa,

Quick update from our side: our speaker (Rahul Mehta) is stuck on I-280 due to an overturned truck and traffic is at a standstill. He’s trying to reroute but likely won’t make the 10:30 slot.

We can do one of the following: 
- Rahul joins remotely (phone/Zoom) if you can provide a clean uplink.
- We send the pre-recorded 18-min talk (we have a final cut ready) and a member of our team can do a short live Q&A from their phone.

I attached the final slide deck and the pre-record file (will upload to Drive if you prefer). Please let us know the cleanest fallback.

Apologies for the scramble, and appreciate the quick help with power/internet.

—Ammika
Ammika Patel | Sponsorship Lead, Aperture Analytics
Attachment: speaker_slide_deck.pptx
message_5_to: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
message_5_cc: Hank Lang <hank@meridianops.com>, Ammika Patel <ammika@apertureanalytics.com>, Venue AV - Onsite <av@meridian-audio.com>
message_5_subject: West Hall A - rollback/status: generator up, bonded SIM live, presenter fallback in place
message_5_body:
Final status and closeout: 

What we did: 
- Generator hooked to Booth 4B at 08:30 (Hank coordinated safe hook-up). UPS towers powered demo racks until generator was live.
- Venue AV activated bonded-SIM failover on the booth VLAN at 09:10. Confirmed steady 4–5 Mbps egress, which covers the demo stream + Zoom uplink. Attached activation stub.
- We staged a standby laptop at the podium with the sponsor deck and local playback; Jasmine will run the pre-record if Rahul can’t join live.
- Sponsor opted for pre-record + 10-minute live Q&A via phone; we tested Q&A dial-in successfully at 11:50.

Attachments included: temp_generator_quote.pdf, bonded_sim_activation.txt

Next steps / post-mortem items for Redwood: 
- Ops note: swap faulty breaker/cable on Monday morning. Request for permanent UPS at Booth 4B for future events.
- Event ops invoice: coordinator to confirm generator hours (TICKET-6728).
- Follow-up email to Aperture (Ammika) to confirm replay file delivery and send speaker recording to marketing for on-demand.

Thanks team — great rapid response. Closing this thread after we get generator usage finalized.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks | Field Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0177
Attachment: temp_generator_quote.pdf, bonded_sim_activation.txt
